new_datasets.title: World Bank WDI · food, crops and livestock · annual country histories
new_datasets.description: Complete available annual country and territory API cells within each indicator’s numeric reporting-year extent. Original API replies, out-of-extent empty cells and regional aggregates remain downloadable; source estimates and missing cells retain their status.
new_datasets.license: World Bank dataset terms, with original provider attribution retained
new_datasets.source_fingerprint_meaning: SHA-256 of canonical per-indicator exact API response and source-metadata checksums plus country/aggregate classification checksum; not an assertion of source measurement certainty.

new_datasets.title: USGS mineral production · annual country histories · 1990–2022
new_datasets.description: Minerals Yearbook world production CSV. Exact material/form/unit dimensions remain separate. Each country/source-year uses its latest available publication vintage; all publisher vintages remain in the downloadable original CSV archive.

world_bank_source_year_rule: Only first-to-last numeric country reporting-year extent is offered as timeline frames; within-range null cells stay in country records. Every out-of-extent API cell and aggregate stays in original source archive.
usgs_vintage_rule: Latest publication year for exact commodity/form/detail/unit/basis/country/source-year. Ambiguous same-latest-vintage rows unavailable, not arbitrarily combined. Complete CSV retains every alternative vintage and all geographies.
